newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to hover between 4,475-4,500 region.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to hover between 4,475-4,500 region.

text.p: After hitting 4,500 on Tuesday the FTSE 100 index may drift down to 4,475 before attempting to go higher again and will probably stay below 4,500, technical analysts said.

Although the downward pressure that proved a drag on the market over a week ago has now been overcome, investors may still harbour doubts about pushing the index up too quickly beyond 4,500, they added.
By 0848 GMT, the index was up 28.3 at 4,483.9 having been as high as 4,503.1 in pre-market trading.
Positive aspects to the market are that its uptrend since mid-April appears intact and the index is now holding well above its 25-day moving average -- which is currently at 4,330.
With Wall Street racing ahead yesterday and buoyancy in the main European bourses, the London stock market should also be able to venture higher over the short-term, analysts said.
Volatile conditions still exist but if the recent past is anything to go by, any sharp declines by the FTSE will be used by investors to accumulate stocks, they added.
On Monday, the Dow closed up 143.29 points to 7,214.49.
